description: This file defines a PHP class 'ckeditorInterface' that provides an interface for integrating CKEditor into a PHP application. It includes methods for creating and rendering CKEditor instances with specific configurations.

classes.name: ckeditorInterface
classes.description: A PHP class that manages CKEditor instances, allowing creation of HTML and configuration of the editor.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the editor interface with a given instance name, creates a new CKEditor object, and sets output return mode.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Outputs the HTML for the editor by calling CreateHtml.

methods.name: CreateHtml
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the CKEditor instance with optional configuration.
